meta.title: Data Transfer Converter — Convert Bit/second and More
meta.description: Free data transfer converter for 11+ units including Bit/second, Kilobit/second, Megabit/second. Instant, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: bit/s, kbps, Mbps, Gbps. Convert between 11 data transfer units instantly, with engineering-grade precision and no signup required.
content.result_section: Pick any two units below to convert between them. The base unit for data transfer in this tool is **bps**; every conversion routes through it for consistency.
content.formula_section: Most data transfer conversions are a single multiplication by a fixed factor. Temperature is the notable exception — it uses additive offsets, not just multiplication. The converter handles both transparently.

content.tips:
Bookmark the conversions you use most — each pair has its own dedicated page with formulas, a lookup table, and FAQs.

When working with derived units (area, volume), remember the factor scales with the dimension: a length factor f becomes f² for area and f³ for volume.
content.faq:
**Q:** How accurate is this data transfer converter?
**A:** It uses 11 canonical unit definitions and 12-digit precision constants.

**Q:** Is it free?
**A:** Yes — completely free, no signup, no limits.

**Q:** Which units are supported?
**A:** Bit/second (bit/s), Kilobit/second (kbit/s), Megabit/second (Mbit/s), Gigabit/second (Gbit/s), Terabit/second (Tbit/s), Byte/second (B/s), Kilobyte/second (KB/s), Megabyte/second (MB/s), Gigabyte/second (GB/s), Kibibit/second (Kibit/s), Mebibit/second (Mibit/s).
